description:
A viral rumor claims Huawei founder Ren Zhengfei and members of his family suddenly disappeared from public view. The rumor itself is unverified—but the reason it spread so quickly points to a much bigger question.
This episode examines Ren Zhengfei’s rise, Huawei’s relationship with China’s political and security establishment, its unusual ownership structure, and whether the founder of one of China’s most strategically important companies could ever truly walk away.

description:
Anthropic says several Chinese AI companies secretly routed user requests to Claude as part of large-scale efforts to copy its capabilities. Some of those requests contained sensitive data linked to Chinese state-owned companies, police systems and PLA-related activity. Anthropic
The same report also describes China-based defense researchers using Claude for military simulations, including a scenario involving 12 targets in Taiwan. We break down how AI “distillation” works—and how China’s race to catch up in AI may be creating a security problem of its own. Anthropic
